name: Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana
benefit: - Under this scheme, youth of Uttarakhand are provided with skill upgradation training in various domains such as language, culture, work ethics, nursing, and hospitality, along with country-specific training. - The training is provided as per the demand of foreign employers to enable the youth to secure suitable service and job opportunities abroad.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand.
